# Hotel Management June/July 2026: Page 13

 

HOTELMANAGEMENT.NET | JUNE/JULY 2026 FEATURES > 13 For the entire article scan the QR code. IT infrastructure, cybersecurity and innovation strategies. We asked these Tech Titans what sets them apart from others in the field. Read the full story online to see more about what technological advancements they are making in their companies—and in the industry as a whole. Stephen Hahn VICE PRESIDENT OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY HOTEL EQUITIES Michael Leidinger SENIOR VICE PRESIDENT AND CHIEF INFORMATION OFFICER HILTON Michael Mahar SVP, HEAD OF COMMERCIAL TECHNOLOGY, DIGITAL AND LOYALTY PRODUCTS WYNDHAM HOTELS & RESORTS What sets me apart is that I’ve always approached technology through an operations lens. My focus has been on helping operators solve problems in a way that is practical, sustainable and easy to adopt. Throughout my career, I’ve worked closely with on-property teams, ownership groups and corporate leaders on everything from system implementations and process redesign to analytics, reporting and operational optimization. The work I’m most proud of is when technology becomes something that helps people do their jobs better, not something that creates another layer of complexity. I help bridge the gap between operations and technology. Operators want tools that are intuitive and effective. Technology teams want scalable systems and clean data. I’ve built my career around connecting these priorities and sourcing the best solutions. I believe in being hands-on and accessible. Some of the best ideas come from property teams because they’re closest to the challenges. Whether I’m evaluating a new platform, troubleshooting a process issue, or helping teams navigate change, I try to stay collaborative and focused on what will create the most long-term value. At Hotel Equities, that approach fits naturally with the company’s broader culture. There’s a strong entrepreneurial mindset here. Teams are encouraged to move quickly, think creatively and stay focused on execution and results. Most important is earning trust from the people directly using the systems. If operators believe the technology is helping them succeed, then we’ve done our job well. What distinguishes my career is the belief that technology leadership is about shaping the future capacity of an enterprise. I have focused on re-architecting organizations so technology becomes a durable strategic advantage. My most significant accomplishment has been leading the transformation of Hilton’s global technology foundation during a period of unprecedented growth and change. Supporting millions of customer interactions and thousands of properties worldwide, Hilton’s core systems had become a potential constraint on innovation, scalability and resilience. The challenge was substantial: Modernize the enterprise technology backbone while maintaining uninterrupted service for customers, owners and team membe

### Stephen Hahn's Biography

Steven joined Hotel Equities through our strategic alliance with Coakley & Williams where he oversaw corporate services which include information technology and office administration. In his new role, Stephen collaborates across all disciplines to improve IT's role in streamlining processes and creating efficiencies. Previously, Stephen held the positions of Chief information Officer and General Manager with Coakley & Williams. In addition to earning his Associate of Arts degree in Hospitality Services Management, he earned his Bachelor of Science Degree in Business Administration from the University of Maryland University College, College Park, MD. He then further advanced his computer-related expertise by earning his Master of Applied Computer Systems Degree from the University of Maryland University College, College Park, MD. In his free time, Stephen likes to randonneur cycle.

results.author: Hotel Equities
results.text:
# In a recent feature with HOTEL MANAGEMENT Magazine, Stephen Hahn, Vice President of Information Technology at Hotel Equities, shares how the company is leveraging technology, automation, and AI to create meaningful operational … | Hotel Equities · LinkedIn · 2026-06-12

**Hotel Equities**: Hotel Equities has 400-500 employees (+10% YoY) and has annual revenue in the $700M-$800M range, founded in 1989. Headquartered in Alpharetta, Georgia, United States, with an office in Atlanta. Its workforce is distributed across 28 countries (including United States, Canada, India, Mexico, and Kenya). Has $500M in total funding.

---

In a recent feature with HOTEL MANAGEMENT Magazine, Stephen Hahn, Vice President of Information Technology at Hotel Equities, shares how the company is leveraging technology, automation, and AI to create meaningful operational improvements across its portfolio.

From streamlining workflows and enhancing labor efficiency to empowering property teams with better insights, Stephen's approach is rooted in a simple philosophy: technology should make hospitality stronger, not more complicated.

"We don’t adopt technology because it’s trendy. We evaluate whether it genuinely improves operations, supports associates, and drives better performance for owners. If it creates unnecessary complexity, we move on."

By combining operational expertise with an entrepreneurial mindset, Hotel Equities continues to invest in a culture where innovation is part of everyday problem-solving.

https://lnkd.in/etZRYzUK

results.title: Redefining Hospitality with AI and Technology
results.author: Alessandra Leoni, MIH
results.text:
# I’m officially in print! 🤓 📖Spilling the tea with CIO Business World on "Redefining Modern Hospitality Through Technology." | Alessandra Leoni, MIH · LinkedIn · 2026-06-11

**Alessandra Leoni, MIH**: MIH Alessandra Leoni currently works as Founder at NextWaveHospitality for 5 months with 24 years 9 months of total professional experience. Previous roles include Head of Commercial & IT at Resident Hotels, Head of Revenue & Distribution at Resident Hotels, and Group Revenue Manager at Resident Hotels. Based in Greater London, England, United Kingdom [GB].

---

I’m officially in print! 🤓 📖Spilling the tea with CIO Business World on "Redefining Modern Hospitality Through Technology."

Spoiler alert: I don’t want robots replacing our superstar teams. My mission? Using smart tech like AI to eliminate boring admin stuff so our humans can do what they do best - spoil our guests!

Huge thanks for the feature!

What’s your thoughts on the future of hotel tech? Let me know below. 👇 #HospitalityTech #LeadershipExcellence #Innovation #GuestExperience #TeamAppreciation

**Reshared from Focus on Hospitality:**
> An immense congratulations to our Head of Hospitality Alessandra Leoni, MIH Leoni on being featured in CIO Business World!
>
> The insightful piece, "𝐑𝐞𝐝𝐞𝐟𝐢𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐌𝐨𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐧 𝐇𝐨𝐬𝐩𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝐓𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡 𝐓𝐞𝐜𝐡𝐧𝐨𝐥𝐨𝐠𝐲," beautifully captures her visionary approach to hospitality transformation.
>
> Alessandra highlights a perspective that perfectly reflects her core values as well as ours: that technology like AI, data analytics, and automated platforms should never replace human connection, but rather empower teams by removing friction.
>
> We are incredibly proud to have our leading voice shaping the conversation around human-centric tech integration.
>
> 👉 Read the full feature here: https://lnkd.in/d92FfEWu
>
